The episode was written by [[Matt Michnovetz]]<ref name="Announcement" />, and will premiere on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer" /> Before its official [[Disney+]] premiere, it was screened for attendees at [[Celebration Japan (2025)|''Star Wars'' Celebration Japan]],<ref name="Title" /> and was released on [[May 2]] in ''[[Fortnite]]'' on the Star Wars Watch Party island 48 hours before they hit Disney+.<ref name="Fortnite" />
